title: Financial Policy and Assignment of Benefits
about: Payment responsibilities, insurance billing and assignment of benefits.

blocks.text: {facility.name} will bill my insurance for the services I receive. I am responsible for any copayment, coinsurance or deductible, and for services my insurance does not cover.
I assign to {facility.name} the insurance benefits payable for my care, and I authorize the release of the information needed to process my claims.
If I have difficulty paying, I may ask about payment plans and any discount program the clinic offers.

blocks.label: I have been told about
items: The clinic's discount or sliding fee program, if it has one

fields.label: If signed by a representative: name
